marks.gloss_en: רבי יהודה אומר: אחד מהן חכם -- מכלל דהנך כל דהו? -- does it follow that the other two may be anyone at all?
אמר רבינא: דמסברי ליה וסבר -- they must be ones to whom it is explained and who understand (= p_ravina_masbri_lei)
'where there is no sage' -- such as whom? Rav Nachman: such as me
the ruling that three permit the firstborn where there is no expert excludes R' Yosei's view
for these blemishes one slaughters the firstborn: its ear was damaged [lacking] from the cartilage

תפשוט מהא, דהך קמייתא משמיה דשמואל איתמר, דאי משמיה דרב -- תרתי למה לי? -- since Rav said 'the halakha is not as R' Yosei', had the uncertain first ruling also been his, he would have said the same thing twice
(proposed) that first ruling was stated in Shmuel's name
חדא מכללא דחבירתה איתמר -- Rav need not have said two things: one may have been reported by inference from the other (= p_chada_mikelala, offered, not asserted)
one [of Rav's two rulings] was stated by inference from the other
Rav Chananel said Rav said: the halakha is not as R' Yosei
אמאי? פסח ועור כתיב! -- why may one slaughter for these [ear] blemishes? the verse writes lame and blind (Deut 15:21)
כתיב נמי כי יהיה בו מום (= p_ki_yihye_bo_mum)
ואימא: כי יהיה בו מום -- כלל, פסח או עור -- פרט; כלל ופרט אין בכלל אלא מה שבפרט: lame and blind yes, anything else no!
it is also written 'if there be a blemish in it' (Deut 15:21) -- [so blemishes beyond lame and blind are included]
כל מום רע -- חזר וכלל; כלל ופרט וכלל אי אתה דן אלא כעין הפרט: exposed blemishes that do not return (= p_klal_uprat_uklal, p_kein_haprat_gilui)
'any ill blemish' -- it generalised again: generalisation, detail, generalisation -- you judge only what is like the detail

ואימא: מה הפרט מפורש -- מומין שבגלוי ובוטל ממלאכתו ואינו חוזר, אף כל...; אלמה תנן נפגמה אזנו מן החסחוס? -- read the prat as also idling the animal from its labour, and the mishna's cartilage-blemish (which does not) would not count
כל מום רע ריבויא הוא (= p_kol_ribuya)

אי הכי, מומין שבסתר נמי? אלמה תנן: חוטין החיצונות שנפגמו ושנגממו והפנימיות שנעקרו -- נעקרו אין, נפגמו ונגממו לא? -- if 'any' amplifies, hidden blemishes too; yet the mishna counts the inner gums only when uprooted
the 'any' of 'any ill blemish' is an amplification
דתנן: ... רבן שמעון בן גמליאל אומר ימכר כולו לגוים חוץ מדמי יין נסך שבו -- the source of the RSbG alignment (kind tanya_kevatei for דתנן, under protest)
libation wine that fell into a cistern: all of it is forbidden for benefit
בכור — ולימא ליה: מאי אפסדתך? the firstborn: let the buyer say, what loss did I cause you [by eating what you could not have used]? -- so why a deduction?
לא צריכא, כגון דזבין ליה ממקום מומא... כרבי יהודה (= p_okimta_mimkom_muma, p_mimkom_muma_kerabbi_yehuda)
it is needed only where he sold him [meat] from the place of the blemish, so the seller says: had you not eaten it, I would have shown it and it would have been permitted to me
טבלים — הוה מתקיננא להו ואכלנא להו (= p_tevalim_matkinna)
יין נסך — על ידי תערובת, וכרבן שמעון בן גמליאל (= p_okimta_yen_nesech_taarovet, p_taarovet_kerashbag)
tevel: [the seller says] I would have rectified it and eaten it
one sold meat and it turned out to be firstborn meat, produce and it was tevel, wine and it was libation wine: what they ate, they ate, and he returns them the money
R' Shimon ben Elazar: things the soul finds repulsive -- he returns them the money
one slaughtered a firstborn and it became known he had not shown it: what they ate, they ate, and he returns them the money
likewise one slaughtered a cow and sold it and it became known it was a tereifa: what they ate, they ate
